label: AB2C_mP16_14_e_2e_e-002
title: $\delta$-LiSmO$_{2}$ Structure
comments: Lanthanide rare-earth lithium oxides (LiLnO$_{2}$) come in several different forms (Faucher, 1998): \begin{itemize} \item $\alpha$-LiLnO$_{2}$: small ions (Ln = Lu, Yb, Er) form in the \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_tI16_141_a_b_e-003}{$\gamma$-LiFeO$_{2}$} structure. \item $\beta$-LiLnO$_{2}$: medium-sized ions (Ln = Y, Ho, Dy, Er) form in the \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_mP16_14_e_e_2e-005}{$\beta$-LiErO$_{2}$} structure. \item $\gamma$-LiLnO$_{2}$: (Ln = Tb, Gd, Eu, Sm) form in the \href{current_web_home_dir/A2BC_oP16_62_2c_c_c-004}{SrZnO$_{2}$} structure. \item $\delta$-LiLnO$_{2}$: (Ln = Eu, Sm, Nd, Pr, La) form in this \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2C_mP16_14_e_2e_e-002}{$\delta$-LiSmO$_{2}$} structure. \end{itemize}
